theorem local_initial_classical_front_exists
    (ν R : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (a : Field) (ha : SmoothSigmaZero a) (hinit : physicalDissipation a ≤ R) :
    ∃ u : Velocity, ∃ p : Pressure,
      InitialClassicalFront ν (localGalerkinTime ν R) a u p := by
  let T : ℝ := localGalerkinTime ν R
  let S : ℝ := 6 * (R + 1) * T + localGalerkinAccumulationBound ν R / ν
  have hT : 0 < T := localGalerkinTime_pos hν hR
  have hS : 0 ≤ S := by
    have hacc := localGalerkinAccumulationBound_nonneg (ν := ν) hR
    dsimp only [S]
    positivity
  have hH2 : ∀ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N → ∀ g : GalerkinSolution ν a N,
      (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..T, ‖g.sobolevState 2 t‖ ^ 2) ≤ S := by
    intro N _hN g
    exact (galerkin_uniform_local_sobolev_bounds ν R hν hR a ha hinit N g).2.2
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := local_sobolev_flow_of_uniform_H2 ν hν a ha T hT S hS hH2
  exact ⟨L.velocity, L.pressure, L.initialClassicalFront hT a ha hL⟩

/-- A single positive lifespan works for every smooth initial datum in the
specified physical H1 ball. Higher smooth norms affect regularity bounds only.
-/
theorem uniform_H1_local_initial_classical_front_exists
    (ν R : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (hR : 0 ≤ R) :
    ∃ T : ℝ, 0 < T ∧ ∀ a : Field, SmoothSigmaZero a → physicalH1Square a ≤ R →
      ∃ u : Velocity, ∃ p : Pressure, InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p := by
  refine ⟨localGalerkinTime ν R, localGalerkinTime_pos hν hR, ?_⟩
  intro a ha hH1
  have hE : 0 ≤ physicalEnergy a := by
    rw [physicalEnergy_eq_integral_norm_sq]
    exact integral_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg ‖a x‖)
  have hinit : physicalDissipation a ≤ R := by
    change physicalEnergy a + physicalDissipation a ≤ R at hH1
    linarith
  exact local_initial_classical_front_exists ν R hν hR a ha hinit

def initialFrontSpacetime (T : ℝ) : Set (ℝ × Vec) :=
  {z | 0 ≤ z.1 ∧ z.1 < T}

/-- A literal finite initial classical pair, with smoothness up to time zero.
Existence of this pair is an explicit input, not inferred from smooth data.
-/
structure InitialClassicalFront (ν T : ℝ) (a : Field)
    (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure) : Prop where
  velocity_smooth :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (initialFrontSpacetime T)
  pressure_smooth :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => p z.1 z.2) (initialFrontSpacetime T)
  velocity_periodic : ∀ t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, SpatialPeriodic (u t)
  pressure_periodic : ∀ t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, SpatialPeriodic (p t)
  divergence_free : ∀ t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ x : Vec, divergence (u t) x = 0
  equation : ∀ t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ x : Vec,
    timeDerivative u t x + convection (u t) x + SingularClosure.gradient (p t) x =
      ν • laplacian (u t) x
  initial : u 0 = a
  velocity_mean_zero : ∀ t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, MeanZero (u t)
  pressure_mean_zero : ∀ t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, PressureMeanZero (p t)

theorem maximal_classical_lifetime_eq_top_of_uniform_H1
    (ν R : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure) (Tmax : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hν : 0 < ν) (H : MaximalClassicalFront ν a u p Tmax)
    (hbound : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ENNReal.ofReal t < Tmax →
      physicalH1Square (u t) ≤ R) : Tmax = ⊤ := by
  have hR : 0 ≤ R :=
    (strongContinuation_physicalH1Square_nonneg (u 0)).trans
      (hbound 0 le_rfl (by simpa only [ENNReal.ofReal_zero] using H.lifetime_pos))
  obtain ⟨h, hh, hlocal⟩ := uniform_H1_local_initial_classical_front_exists ν R hν hR
  by_contra hfinite
  let τ : ℝ := Tmax.toReal
  have hτ : 0 < τ := ENNReal.toReal_pos H.lifetime_pos.ne' hfinite
  let s : ℝ := max (τ / 2) (τ - h / 2)
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := by
    exact (by linarith : 0 ≤ τ / 2).trans (le_max_left (τ / 2) (τ - h / 2))
  have hsτ : s < τ := by
    exact max_lt (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hreach : τ < s + h := by
    have hnear : τ - h / 2 ≤ s := le_max_right (τ / 2) (τ - h / 2)
    linarith
  let T : ℝ := (s + τ) / 2
  have hsT : s < T := by dsimp only [T]; linarith
  have hTτ : T < τ := by dsimp only [T]; linarith
  have hT : 0 < T := hs0.trans_lt hsT
  have hTmax : ENNReal.ofReal T < Tmax :=
    (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_iff_lt_toReal hT.le hfinite).mpr hTτ
  have hsmax : ENNReal.ofReal s < Tmax :=
    (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_iff_lt_toReal hs0 hfinite).mpr hsτ
  have HF : InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p := H.finite_front T hT hTmax
  have hdata : SmoothSigmaZero (u s) :=
    initial_front_smooth_slices ν T a u p HF s ⟨hs0, hsT⟩
  obtain ⟨v, q, K⟩ := hlocal (u s) hdata (hbound s hs0 hsmax)
  obtain ⟨U, P, Hlong, _⟩ := initial_front_extend_from_restart ν T s h a u v p q
    hν HF ⟨hs0, hsT⟩ hh K (hTτ.trans hreach)
  have hlong : ENNReal.ofReal (s + h) ≤ Tmax :=
    H.no_extension (s + h) U P (hτ.trans hreach) Hlong
  have hstrict : Tmax < ENNReal.ofReal (s + h) := by
    calc
      Tmax = ENNReal.ofReal τ := (ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hfinite).symm
      _ < ENNReal.ofReal (s + h) :=
        (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff_of_nonneg hτ.le).mpr hreach
  exact (not_le_of_gt hstrict) hlong

theorem initial_front_extends_of_dissipation_square
    (ν T : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hT : 0 < T) (H : InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p)
    (hD : Integrable (fun t => physicalDissipation (u t) ^ 2)
      (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T))) :
    ∃ S : ℝ, T < S ∧ ∃ (U : Velocity) (P : Pressure),
      InitialClassicalFront ν S a U P ∧
        ∀ t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, U t = u t ∧ P t = p t := by
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hbound⟩ := initial_front_uniform_H1_of_dissipation_square
    ν T a u p hν hT H hD
  obtain ⟨h, hh, hlocal⟩ := uniform_H1_local_initial_classical_front_exists ν R hν hR
  let s : ℝ := max (T / 2) (T - h / 2)
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ s :=
    (by linarith : 0 ≤ T / 2).trans (le_max_left (T / 2) (T - h / 2))
  have hsT : s < T := max_lt (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hreach : T < s + h := by
    have hnear : T - h / 2 ≤ s := le_max_right (T / 2) (T - h / 2)
    linarith
  have hdata : SmoothSigmaZero (u s) :=
    initial_front_smooth_slices ν T a u p H s ⟨hs0, hsT⟩
  obtain ⟨v, q, K⟩ := hlocal (u s) hdata (hbound s ⟨hs0, hsT⟩)
  obtain ⟨U, P, Hlong, hagree, _⟩ := initial_front_extend_from_restart
    ν T s h a u v p q hν H ⟨hs0, hsT⟩ hh K hreach
  exact ⟨s + h, hreach, U, P, Hlong, hagree⟩

/-- A finite maximal classical lifetime cannot have finite actual physical
enstrophy-square integral over its entire open pre-endpoint interval.
-/
theorem maximal_classical_front_no_finite_dissipation_square
    (ν : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure) (Tmax : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hν : 0 < ν) (H : MaximalClassicalFront ν a u p Tmax)
    (hfinite : Tmax ≠ ⊤)
    (hD : Integrable (fun t => physicalDissipation (u t) ^ 2)
      (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) Tmax.toReal))) : False := by
  have hT : 0 < Tmax.toReal := ENNReal.toReal_pos H.lifetime_pos.ne' hfinite
  have HF := maximal_classical_front_restrict_le ν Tmax.toReal a u p Tmax H hT
    (ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hfinite).le
  obtain ⟨R, _, hR⟩ := initial_front_uniform_H1_of_dissipation_square
    ν Tmax.toReal a u p hν hT HF hD
  have htop : Tmax = ⊤ := maximal_classical_lifetime_eq_top_of_uniform_H1
    ν R a u p Tmax hν H (by
      intro t ht htmax
      exact hR t ⟨ht, (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_iff_lt_toReal ht hfinite).mp htmax⟩)
  exact hfinite htop

abbrev CriticalPhysicalL2 := Lp Vec 2 (volume.restrict unitCube)

/-- The actual physical L2 equivalence class whenever the representative is
square integrable.  The zero branch is irrelevant on every stated energy class. -/
def criticalL2Representative {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] (f : Vec → E) :
    Lp E 2 (volume.restrict unitCube) := by
  classical
  exact if hf : MemLp f 2 (volume.restrict unitCube) then hf.toLp f else 0

theorem criticalL2Representative_eq {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    (f : Vec → E) (hf : MemLp f 2 (volume.restrict unitCube)) :
    criticalL2Representative f = hf.toLp f := by
  simp only [criticalL2Representative, dif_pos hf]

structure CriticalLerayHopf
    (ν : ℝ) (a₀ : CriticalPhysicalL2) (v : Velocity)
    (G : ℝ → Vec → (Vec →L[ℝ] Vec)) : Prop where
  momentum : CriticalIntegratedWeakMomentum ν v
  velocity_L2 : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → MemLp (v t) 2 (volume.restrict unitCube)
  velocity_energy_class : ∀ T : ℝ, 0 < T →
    MemLp (fun t => criticalL2Representative (v t)) ∞ (volume.restrict (Ioc (0 : ℝ) T))
  gradient_energy_class : ∀ T : ℝ, 0 < T →
    MemLp (fun t => criticalL2Representative (G t)) 2 (volume.restrict (Ioc (0 : ℝ) T))
  initial : v 0 =ᵐ[volume.restrict unitCube] (a₀ : Vec → Vec)
  weak_continuity : ∀ φ : Field, MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict unitCube) →
    ContinuousOn (fun t => physicalFieldInner (v t) φ) (Ici 0)
  strong_trace : Tendsto
    (fun t => eLpNorm (v t - (a₀ : Vec → Vec)) 2 (volume.restrict unitCube))
    (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 0)
  spatial_H1 : ∀ T : ℝ, 0 < T →
    ∀ᵐ t ∂volume.restrict (Ioc (0 : ℝ) T), CriticalPhysicalH1 (v t) (G t)
  dissipation_integrable : ∀ T : ℝ, 0 < T →
    IntervalIntegrable (fun t => criticalGradientEnergy (G t)) volume 0 T
  energy_initial : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t →
    physicalEnergy (v t) + 2 * ν * (∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..t, criticalGradientEnergy (G r)) ≤ ‖a₀‖ ^ 2
  energy_intervals : ∀ T : ℝ, 0 < T →
    ∀ᵐ s ∂volume.restrict (Ioc (0 : ℝ) T), ∀ t ∈ Icc s T,
      physicalEnergy (v t) + 2 * ν * (∫ r in s..t, criticalGradientEnergy (G r)) ≤
        physicalEnergy (v s)

theorem lh_strong_right_trace_of_energy_start
    {ν : ℝ} {a₀ : CriticalPhysicalL2} {v : Velocity}
    {G : ℝ → Vec → (Vec →L[ℝ] Vec)}
    (hv : CriticalLerayHopf ν a₀ v G) (hν : 0 ≤ ν)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hE : ∀ r : ℝ, s ≤ r → physicalEnergy (v r) +
      2 * ν * (∫ q in s..r, criticalGradientEnergy (G q)) ≤ physicalEnergy (v s)) :
    Tendsto (fun t => criticalL2Representative (v t))
      (𝓝[>] s) (𝓝 (criticalL2Representative (v s))) := by
  have hvs := hv.velocity_L2 s hs
  have hc := (hv.weak_continuity (v s) hvs) s hs

      (timeTranslate s v) (timeTranslate s G) := by
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := hs
  have hvs := hv.velocity_L2 s hs0
  refine {
    momentum := timeTranslate_integrated_momentum hv.momentum hs0
    velocity_L2 := fun t ht => hv.velocity_L2 (t + s) (add_nonneg ht hs0)
    velocity_energy_class := fun T hT =>

    (hu : CriticalPositiveSolenoidalTest u)

    (hpp : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → SpatialPeriodic (p r))
    (hNSE : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → ∀ x : Vec,
      timeDerivative u r x + convection (u r) x + gradient (p r) x =
        ν • laplacian (u r) x)
    (hu_trace : Tendsto
      (fun t => eLpNorm (u t - (a₀ : Vec → Vec)) 2 (volume.restrict unitCube))
      (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 0))
    (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T)

      (volume.restrict (Ioc (0 : ℝ) T))) :
    ∀ t ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) T, v t =ᵐ[volume.restrict unitCube] u t := by

  let U : ℝ → ℝ := fun r => criticalSpatialNorm 6 (u r)
  let B : ℝ → ℝ := fun r => 216 * C ^ 4 * (U r) ^ 4 / ν ^ 3 +
    3 * C ^ 2 * (U r) ^ 2 / ν
  let A : ℝ → ℝ := fun r => 2 * B r
  let E : ℝ → ℝ := fun r => physicalEnergy (v r - u r)
  have hUc : ContinuousOn U (Ioc (0 : ℝ) T) :=
    hu.eLpNorm_six_toReal_continuousOn T
  have hBc : ContinuousOn B (Ioc (0 : ℝ) T) :=
    ((continuousOn_const.mul (hUc.pow 4)).div_const (ν ^ 3)).add
      ((continuousOn_const.mul (hUc.pow 2)).div_const ν)
  have hAc : ContinuousOn A (Ioc (0 : ℝ) T) := continuousOn_const.mul hBc
  have hAnonneg : ∀ r ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) T, 0 ≤ A r := by
    intro r hr
    dsimp [A, B]
    positivity
  have hEnonneg : ∀ r ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) T, 0 ≤ E r := by
    intro r hr
    dsimp [E]
    rw [physicalEnergy_eq_integral_norm_sq]
    exact integral_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg _)
  haveI : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict (Ioc (0 : ℝ) T)) :=
    ⟨by simp only [Measure.restrict_apply_univ, Real.volume_Ioc]; finiteness⟩
  have hBI : IntervalIntegrable B volume 0 T :=
    (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le hT.le).mpr
      (criticalSerrinEnergyCoefficient_integrable ν C U hSerrin)
  have hAI : IntervalIntegrable A volume 0 T := hBI.const_mul 2
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hε_zero⟩ := CRITICAL_ADMISSIBLE_TIMES_TENDSTO_ZERO hT
    (fun s => ∀ t ∈ Icc s T, physicalEnergy (v t) +
      2 * ν * (∫ r in s..t, criticalGradientEnergy (G r)) ≤ physicalEnergy (v s))
    (hv.energy_intervals T hT)
  have hεWithin : Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) :=
    tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨hε_zero, Eventually.of_forall (fun n => (hε n).1.1)⟩
  have hvε (n : ℕ) : MemLp (v (ε n)) 2 (volume.restrict unitCube) :=
    hv.velocity_L2 (ε n) (hε n).1.1.le
  have huε (n : ℕ) : MemLp (u (ε n)) 2 (volume.restrict unitCube) :=
    critical_continuous_memLp_cube _ (hu.spatial_smooth (hε n).1.1).continuous 2
  have ha₀ : MemLp (a₀ : Vec → Vec) 2 (volume.restrict unitCube) := Lp.memLp a₀
  have hv_trace_L2 := critical_toLp_tendsto_of_eLpNorm_sub
    (fun n => v (ε n)) (a₀ : Vec → Vec) hvε ha₀ (hv.strong_trace.comp hεWithin)
  have hu_trace_L2 := critical_toLp_tendsto_of_eLpNorm_sub
    (fun n => u (ε n)) (a₀ : Vec → Vec) huε ha₀ (hu_trace.comp hεWithin)
  have htrace : Tendsto (fun n => E (ε n)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have heq (n : ℕ) : E (ε n) =
        ‖(hvε n).toLp (v (ε n)) - (huε n).toLp (u (ε n))‖ ^ 2 :=
      critical_physicalEnergy_sub_eq_norm_toLp_sub_sq _ _ (hvε n) (huε n)
    simpa only [heq, sub_self, norm_zero, zero_pow (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)] using
      (hv_trace_L2.sub hu_trace_L2).norm.pow 2
  have hprod (n : ℕ) : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => A r * E r) volume (ε n) T :=
    CRITICAL_RELATIVE_ENERGY_PRODUCT_INTERVAL_INTEGRABLE hv hu A (ε n) T
      (hε n).1.1 (hε n).1.2 (hAc.mono (fun r hr =>
        ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le (hε n).1.1 hr.1, hr.2⟩))
  have hrelative : ∀ n t, t ∈ Icc (ε n) T →
      E t ≤ E (ε n) + ∫ r in ε n..t, A r * E r := by
    intro n t ht
    have htpos : 0 < t := lt_of_lt_of_le (hε n).1.1 ht.1
    have hcoefB : ContinuousOn B (Icc (ε n) t) := hBc.mono (fun r hr =>
      ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le (hε n).1.1 hr.1, hr.2.trans ht.2⟩)
    have hBE : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => B r * E r) volume (ε n) t :=
      CRITICAL_RELATIVE_ENERGY_PRODUCT_INTERVAL_INTEGRABLE hv hu B (ε n) t
        (hε n).1.1 ht.1 hcoefB
    obtain ⟨hD, hR, hrel⟩ := CRITICAL_LH_SMOOTH_RELATIVE_ENERGY_TRANSPORT
      ν hν a₀ v u G p hv hu hp hpp hNSE (ε n) t (hε n).1.1 ht.1 ((hε n).2 t ht)
    have hupper : IntervalIntegrable (fun r =>
        (ν / 2) * criticalGradientEnergy (G r - fderiv ℝ (u r)) + B r * E r)
        volume (ε n) t := (hD.const_mul (ν / 2)).add hBE
    have hH1 : ∀ᵐ r ∂volume.restrict (Ioc (ε n) t), CriticalPhysicalH1 (v r) (G r) :=
      ae_restrict_of_ae_restrict_of_subset (Ioc_subset_Ioc (hε n).1.1.le le_rfl)
        (hv.spatial_H1 t htpos)
    have hpoint : (fun r => criticalRoughTransport (v r - u r)
        (G r - fderiv ℝ (u r)) (u r)) ≤ᵐ[volume.restrict (Ioc (ε n) t)]
        (fun r => (ν / 2) * criticalGradientEnergy (G r - fderiv ℝ (u r)) + B r * E r) := by
      filter_upwards [hH1, ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with r hHr hr
      have hrpos : 0 < r := (hε n).1.1.trans hr.1
      have hus := hu.spatial_smooth hrpos
      exact (le_abs_self _).trans (htransport ν hν (u r) (v r - u r)
        (G r - fderiv ℝ (u r)) (critical_continuous_memLp_cube _ hus.continuous 6)
        (hHr.sub_smooth (u r) hus (hu.periodic r hrpos)))
    have hbound : (∫ r in ε n..t, criticalRoughTransport (v r - u r)
        (G r - fderiv ℝ (u r)) (u r)) ≤
        (ν / 2) * (∫ r in ε n..t, criticalGradientEnergy (G r - fderiv ℝ (u r))) +
          (∫ r in ε n..t, B r * E r) := by
      calc
        _ ≤ ∫ r in ε n..t,
            (ν / 2) * criticalGradientEnergy (G r - fderiv ℝ (u r)) + B r * E r := by
          rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le ht.1, intervalIntegral.integral_of_le ht.1]
          exact setIntegral_mono_ae_restrict hR.1 hupper.1 hpoint
        _ = _ := by
          rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add (hD.const_mul (ν / 2)) hBE,
            intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    have hDnonneg : 0 ≤ ∫ r in ε n..t,
        criticalGradientEnergy (G r - fderiv ℝ (u r)) :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg_of_forall ht.1
        (fun r => criticalGradientEnergy_nonneg _)
    have hAint : (∫ r in ε n..t, A r * E r) = 2 * (∫ r in ε n..t, B r * E r) := by
      simp only [A, mul_assoc, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    change E t + 2 * ν * (∫ r in ε n..t,
      criticalGradientEnergy (G r - fderiv ℝ (u r))) ≤
      E (ε n) + 2 * (∫ r in ε n..t,
        criticalRoughTransport (v r - u r) (G r - fderiv ℝ (u r)) (u r)) at hrel
    rw [hAint]
    nlinarith only [hrel, hbound, mul_nonneg hν.le hDnonneg]
  have hzero := CRITICAL_RELATIVE_ENERGY_ZERO_OF_LOCAL_ADMISSIBLE_TRACE hT
    hEnonneg hAc hAnonneg hAI hprod (le_refl (∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..T, A r))
    (fun n => (hε n).1) hε_zero htrace hrelative
  intro t ht
  have hvL2 := hv.velocity_L2 t ht.1.le
  have huL2 : MemLp (u t) 2 (volume.restrict unitCube) :=
    critical_continuous_memLp_cube _ (hu.spatial_smooth ht.1).continuous 2
  have hd := hvL2.sub huL2
  have hn : ‖hd.toLp (v t - u t)‖ = 0 := by
    have hsq : ‖hd.toLp (v t - u t)‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by
      rw [← critical_physicalEnergy_eq_norm_toLp_sq (v t - u t) hd]

  have hz : hd.toLp (v t - u t) = 0 := norm_eq_zero.mp hn
  have hzae : (v t - u t) =ᵐ[volume.restrict unitCube] (0 : Field) :=
    hd.coeFn_toLp.symm.trans (Lp.eq_zero_iff_ae_eq_zero.mp hz)
  filter_upwards [hzae] with x hx
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hx

theorem strong_tendsto_of_inner_and_norm_bound
    {ι : Type*} {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {l : Filter ι} {f : ι → E} {a : E}
    (hinner : Tendsto (fun i => inner ℝ (f i) a) l (𝓝 (‖a‖ ^ 2)))
    (hbound : ∀ᶠ i in l, ‖f i‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖a‖ ^ 2) :
    Tendsto f l (𝓝 a) := by
  have hupper : Tendsto (fun i => 2 * ‖a‖ ^ 2 - 2 * inner ℝ (f i) a)
      l (𝓝 0) := by
    have hconst : Tendsto (fun _ : ι => 2 * ‖a‖ ^ 2) l (𝓝 (2 * ‖a‖ ^ 2)) :=
      tendsto_const_nhds
    have htwo : Tendsto (fun i => 2 * inner ℝ (f i) a)
        l (𝓝 (2 * ‖a‖ ^ 2)) := tendsto_const_nhds.mul hinner
    simpa only [sub_self] using hconst.sub htwo
  have hsq : Tendsto (fun i => ‖f i - a‖ ^ 2) l (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := by
    apply squeeze_zero' (Eventually.of_forall (fun i => sq_nonneg ‖f i - a‖))
      ?_ hupper
    filter_upwards [hbound] with i hi
    -- EP030: the real Hilbert squared-distance identity supplies the bound.
    rw [norm_sub_sq_real]
    linarith
  have hsqrt := Real.continuous_sqrt.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hsq
  have hn : Tendsto (fun i => ‖f i - a‖) l (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_zero]
      using hsqrt
  apply tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero.mpr
  simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using hn

/-- D05.03: weak continuity of the selected pairing on the nonnegative
time domain and the supplied energy-start inequality imply a strong right
trace at s. Only that pairing, rather than full strong continuity, is assumed. -/
theorem strong_right_trace_of_energy_start
    {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    {u : ℝ → H} {D : ℝ → ℝ} {ν s : ℝ}
    (hν : 0 ≤ ν) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hD : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → 0 ≤ D r)
    (hweak : ContinuousOn (fun t => inner ℝ (u t) (u s)) (Ici (0 : ℝ)))
    (hE : ∀ r : ℝ, s ≤ r →
      ‖u r‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ν * (∫ q in s..r, D q) ≤ ‖u s‖ ^ 2) :
    Tendsto u (𝓝[>] s) (𝓝 (u s)) := by
  have hc := hweak s hs
  have hi : Tendsto (fun t => inner ℝ (u t) (u s))
      (𝓝[>] s) (𝓝 (inner ℝ (u s) (u s))) :=
    hc.tendsto.mono_left (nhdsWithin_mono _
      (show Ioi s ⊆ Ici (0 : ℝ) from fun t ht => hs.trans ht.le))
  -- EP029: the selected weak pairing supplies the limit, while the scalar
  -- energy inequality supplies the eventual norm bound.
  apply strong_tendsto_of_inner_and_norm_bound
  · simpa only [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] using hi
  · filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with t ht
    exact energy_le_of_energy_start hν hs hD hE ht.le

/-- D05.03 / EP031: the strong right trace becomes the zero-start trace
of the translated trajectory. -/
theorem shifted_strong_trace_of_energy_start
    {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    {u : ℝ → H} {D : ℝ → ℝ} {ν s : ℝ}
    (hν : 0 ≤ ν) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hD : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → 0 ≤ D r)
    (hweak : ContinuousOn (fun t => inner ℝ (u t) (u s)) (Ici (0 : ℝ)))
    (hE : ∀ r : ℝ, s ≤ r →
      ‖u r‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ν * (∫ q in s..r, D q) ≤ ‖u s‖ ^ 2) :
    Tendsto (timeTranslate s u) (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 (u s)) := by
  -- EP031 composes the proved right trace with the translated source filter.
  have h := (strong_right_trace_of_energy_start hν hs hD hweak hE).comp
    (timeTranslate_tendsto_nhdsWithin_right s)
  change Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => u (t + s)) (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 (u s))
  exact h

structure ComparisonData
    (u v : ℝ → V) (a₀ : V) (T : ℝ)
    (g : ℝ → ℝ) (Good : ℝ → Prop) : Prop where
  coefficient_continuous : ContinuousOn g (Ioc (0 : ℝ) T)
  coefficient_nonnegative : ∀ t ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) T, 0 ≤ g t
  coefficient_integrable : IntervalIntegrable g volume (0 : ℝ) T
  relative_energy_integrable :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun r => g r * ‖u r - v r‖ ^ 2) volume (0 : ℝ) T
  good_ae : ∀ᵐ r ∂volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T), Good r
  left_trace : Tendsto u (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 a₀)
  right_trace : Tendsto v (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 a₀)
  left_initial : u 0 = a₀
  right_initial : v 0 = a₀
  relative_energy : ∀ r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, Good r →
    ∀ t ∈ Icc r T,
      ‖u t - v t‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖u r - v r‖ ^ 2 +
        ∫ q in r..t, g q * ‖u q - v q‖ ^ 2

/-- Finite comparison data for every positive horizon. The witnesses `g`
and `Good` may vary with that horizon. This definition assumes the actual
comparison premises; it contains no trajectory-equality field. -/
def ComparableOnNonnegative (u v : ℝ → V) (a₀ : V) : Prop :=
  ∀ T : ℝ, 0 < T → ∃ g : ℝ → ℝ, ∃ Good : ℝ → Prop,
    ComparisonData u v a₀ T g Good

/-- The existing closed-horizon endpoint consumes every field of the exact
finite comparison data, including its all-upper-endpoint relative energy. -/
theorem ComparisonData.eq_on_Icc
    {u v : ℝ → V} {a₀ : V} {T : ℝ} {g : ℝ → ℝ} {Good : ℝ → Prop}
    (h : ComparisonData u v a₀ T g Good) (hT : 0 < T) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, u t = v t := by
  exact QFA.Assembly.Comparison.eq_on_Icc_of_ae_relative_energy
    hT h.coefficient_continuous h.coefficient_nonnegative
    h.coefficient_integrable h.relative_energy_integrable h.good_ae
    h.left_trace h.right_trace h.left_initial h.right_initial h.relative_energy

/-- Finite-horizon comparison gives equality at every nonnegative time.
No global coefficient or integrability over the infinite interval is required. -/
theorem ComparableOnNonnegative.eq_on_nonnegative
    {u v : ℝ → V} {a₀ : V}
    (h : ComparableOnNonnegative u v a₀) :
    ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → u t = v t := by
  intro t ht
  have hT : 0 < t + 1 := by linarith
  obtain ⟨g, Good, hdata⟩ := h (t + 1) hT
  exact hdata.eq_on_Icc hT t ⟨ht, by linarith⟩

def nonlinearCoefficient (E D : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt ((E * D) / (4 * Real.pi ^ 2)))

theorem nonlinearCoefficient_nonneg (E D : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ nonlinearCoefficient E D :=
  -- EP112: the outer square root is nonnegative for every real radicand.
  Real.sqrt_nonneg _

/-- Exact coefficient identity; denominator positivity is independent of E,D. -/
theorem nonlinearCoefficient_fourth
    {E D : ℝ} (hE : 0 ≤ E) (hD : 0 ≤ D) :
    4 * Real.pi ^ 2 * nonlinearCoefficient E D ^ 4 = E * D := by
  have hq : 0 ≤ (E * D) / (4 * Real.pi ^ 2) :=
    div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hE hD) four_pi_sq_pos.le
  have hfourth : nonlinearCoefficient E D ^ 4 = (E * D) / (4 * Real.pi ^ 2) := by
    unfold nonlinearCoefficient
    -- EP112 and EP113: the two nested square roots have the prescribed fourth power.
    rw [sqrt_fourth _ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _), Real.sq_sqrt hq]
  rw [hfourth]
  calc
    4 * Real.pi ^ 2 * ((E * D) / (4 * Real.pi ^ 2)) =
        ((E * D) / (4 * Real.pi ^ 2)) * (4 * Real.pi ^ 2) := mul_comm _ _
    _ = E * D := div_mul_cancel₀ _ four_pi_sq_pos.ne'

/-- The frozen product threshold produces a strictly positive viscosity margin. -/
theorem nonlinearCoefficient_lt_viscosity
    {E D ν : ℝ} (hE : 0 ≤ E) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hν : 0 < ν)
    (hSmall : E * D < 4 * Real.pi ^ 2 * ν ^ 4) :
    nonlinearCoefficient E D < ν := by
  have hscaled : (4 * Real.pi ^ 2) * nonlinearCoefficient E D ^ 4 <
      (4 * Real.pi ^ 2) * ν ^ 4 := by
    rw [nonlinearCoefficient_fourth hE hD]
    exact hSmall
  have hpow : nonlinearCoefficient E D ^ 4 < ν ^ 4 :=
    lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left hscaled four_pi_sq_pos.le
  -- EP116: strict fourth-power comparison reflects through nonnegative viscosity.
  exact lt_of_pow_lt_pow_left₀ 4 hν.le hpow

/-- Quantitative nonlinear estimate, including all zero-energy cases. -/
theorem ScalarProfile.nonlinear_le_coefficient
    {E D Z A N : ℝ} (h : ScalarProfile E D Z A N) :
    N ≤ nonlinearCoefficient E D * Z := by
  apply nonlinear_le_of_product_le h.laplacian_nonneg (nonlinearCoefficient_nonneg E D)
    h.nonlinear_fourth_power
  exact le_of_eq (nonlinearCoefficient_fourth h.energy_nonneg h.gradient_nonneg).symm

/-- Explicit zero-dissipation case; no cancellation by Z is used. -/
theorem ScalarProfile.nonlinear_eq_zero_of_laplacian_eq_zero
    {E D Z A N : ℝ} (h : ScalarProfile E D Z A N) (hZ : Z = 0) : N = 0 := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · simpa only [hZ, mul_zero] using h.nonlinear_le_coefficient
  · exact h.nonlinear_nonneg

/-- A purely scalar absorption step for an already supplied enstrophy inequality.

The real number `d` denotes its derivative value; this theorem asserts no
derivative existence or Navier--Stokes identity.
-/
theorem ScalarProfile.enstrophy_absorption
    {E D Z A N d ν : ℝ} (h : ScalarProfile E D Z A N)
    (hEnstrophy : d / 2 + ν * Z ≤ N) :
    d + 2 * (ν - nonlinearCoefficient E D) * Z ≤ 0 := by
  have hNonlinear := h.nonlinear_le_coefficient
  nlinarith only [hEnstrophy, hNonlinear]

/-- Positive uniform dissipation margin under the strict product threshold. -/
theorem ScalarProfile.viscosity_margin_pos
    {E D Z A N ν : ℝ} (h : ScalarProfile E D Z A N) (hν : 0 < ν)
    (hSmall : E * D < 4 * Real.pi ^ 2 * ν ^ 4) :
    0 < ν - nonlinearCoefficient E D :=
  sub_pos.mpr (nonlinearCoefficient_lt_viscosity h.energy_nonneg h.gradient_nonneg hν hSmall)

theorem exists_absorption_of_compactSchwartzData
    (hSpectral : WholeSpaceSpectralEndpoint)
    (hAgmon : WholeSpaceAgmonEndpoint)
    {v L : RealL2} {G : Fin 3 → RealL2} {N d ν : ℝ}
    (hDerivatives : CompactSchwartzDerivativeWitnesses (complexifyL2 v)
      (fun j => complexifyL2 (G j)) (complexifyL2 L))
    (hN : 0 ≤ N)
    (hConvection : ∀ V : Space →ᵇ ComplexVector,
      (fun x : Space => V x) =ᵐ[volume] (fun x : Space => complexifyL2 v x) →
        N ≤ ‖V‖ * Real.sqrt (∑ j : Fin 3, ‖G j‖ ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (‖L‖ ^ 2))
    (hν : 0 < ν)
    (hSmall : (‖v‖ ^ 2) * (∑ j : Fin 3, ‖G j‖ ^ 2) < 4 * Real.pi ^ 2 * ν ^ 4)
    (hEnstrophy : d / 2 + ν * ‖L‖ ^ 2 ≤ N) :
    ∃ η : ℝ,
      η = ν - nonlinearCoefficient (‖v‖ ^ 2) (∑ j : Fin 3, ‖G j‖ ^ 2) ∧
      0 < η ∧
      4 * Real.pi ^ 2 * N ^ 4 ≤
        ((‖v‖ ^ 2) * (∑ j : Fin 3, ‖G j‖ ^ 2)) * (‖L‖ ^ 2) ^ 4 ∧
      N ≤ (ν - η) * ‖L‖ ^ 2 ∧
      d + 2 * η * ‖L‖ ^ 2 ≤ 0 := by
  have hSchwartz : SchwartzDerivativeWitnesses (complexifyL2 v)
      (fun j => complexifyL2 (G j)) (complexifyL2 L) :=
    schwartzDerivativeWitnesses_of_compactSchwartz_unconditional hDerivatives
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hProfile⟩ := exists_scalarProfile_of_analytic_endpoints
    (interpolationEndpoint_of_spectralEndpoint hSpectral) hAgmon hSchwartz hN
    (by
      intro V hV
      simpa only [complexifyL2_gradientEnergy, complexifyL2_laplacianEnergy]
        using hConvection V hV)
  have hProfileReal :
      ScalarProfile (‖v‖ ^ 2) (∑ j : Fin 3, ‖G j‖ ^ 2) (‖L‖ ^ 2) ‖V‖ N := by
    simpa only [complexifyL2_velocityEnergy, complexifyL2_gradientEnergy,
      complexifyL2_laplacianEnergy] using hProfile
  refine ⟨ν - nonlinearCoefficient (‖v‖ ^ 2) (∑ j : Fin 3, ‖G j‖ ^ 2),
    rfl, hProfileReal.viscosity_margin_pos hν hSmall,
    hProfileReal.nonlinear_fourth_power, ?_,
    hProfileReal.enstrophy_absorption hEnstrophy⟩
  have hCoefficient : ν -
      (ν - nonlinearCoefficient (‖v‖ ^ 2) (∑ j : Fin 3, ‖G j‖ ^ 2)) =
      nonlinearCoefficient (‖v‖ ^ 2) (∑ j : Fin 3, ‖G j‖ ^ 2) := by ring
  simpa only [hCoefficient] using hProfileReal.nonlinear_le_coefficient

def strongSolution_of_compact_slab {ν a b : ℝ} {u f : VelocityField} {p : PressureField}
    {K : Set Space} (hab : a < b) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u (slab a b)) (hp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ p (slab a b))
    (hsupp : ∀ r ∈ Icc a b, tsupport (fun x => u (r, x)) ⊆ K)
    (hdiv : ∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, ∀ x, spatialDivergence u t x = 0)
    (hNS : ∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, ∀ x, navierStokesResidual ν u p t x = f (t, x)) :
    StrongSolutionOnIcc ν f a b u p where
  time_lt := hab
  curve := h3Curve_of_compact_slab hab hK hu hsupp
  timeDerivative := fun z => temporalDerivative u z.1 z.2
  timeDerivative_memLp := fun _ ht => temporalDerivative_memLp_of_compact hK hu hsupp ht
  hasDerivAt_velocity := fun _ ht => hasDerivAt_velocityLp_of_compact hK hu hsupp ht _
  pressure_C1 := fun _ ht => (spatial_smooth hp (Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht)).of_le (by simp)
  divergence_free := fun t ht => Filter.Eventually.of_forall (hdiv t ht)
  navier_stokes := fun t ht => Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => by
    change temporalDerivative u t x + weakAdvection (fun x => u (t, x))
      (fun i x => H3Compact.partialField i u (t, x)) x -
      ν • NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.spatialLaplacian u t x +
      NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.pressureGradient p t x = _
    rw [weakAdvection_eq_advection]
    exact hNS t ht x)

theorem strong_unique {ν T : ℝ} (hν : 0 ≤ ν)
    {f u v : VelocityField} {p q : PressureField}
    (hu : StrongSolutionOnIcc ν f 0 T u p) (hv : StrongSolutionOnIcc ν f 0 T v q)
    (hf : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, MemLp (fun x => f (t, x)) 2 volume)
    (A : ℝ → Space → Space →L[ℝ] Space) {G : ℝ} (hG : 0 ≤ G)
    (hAm : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, AEStronglyMeasurable (A t) volume)
    (hAb : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ x, ‖A t x‖ ≤ G)
    (hAe : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, ∀ z : Space,
      A t x z = ∑ i : Fin 3, z i • hu.curve.first i (t, x))
    (hinitial : ∀ x, u (0, x) = v (0, x)) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ x, u (t, x) = v (t, x) := by
  have hpu t ht := hu.pressureGradient_memLp ht (hf t ht)
  have hpv t ht := hv.pressureGradient_memLp ht (hf t ht)
  apply strong_unique_of_pressure_pairing hν hu hv A hG hAm hAb hAe
    (fun t ht => (hpu t ht).sub (hpv t ht)) _ hinitial
  intro t ht
  let hw := (hu.curve.approximation t (Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht)).sub
    (hv.curve.approximation t (Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht))
  have hd : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume,
      ∑ i : Fin 3, (hu.curve.first i (t, x) - hv.curve.first i (t, x)) i = 0 := by
    filter_upwards [hu.divergence_free t ht, hv.divergence_free t ht] with x hux hvx
    simp only [weakDivergence] at hux hvx
    simp only [PiLp.sub_apply, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hux, hvx, sub_self]
  have hup := integral_inner_pressureGradient_zero hw.toH1Approximation hd
    (hu.pressure_C1 t ht) (hpu t ht)
  have hvp := integral_inner_pressureGradient_zero hw.toH1Approximation hd
    (hv.pressure_C1 t ht) (hpv t ht)
  have hi := integral_sub (integrable_inner_of_memLp hw.memLp (hpu t ht))
    (integrable_inner_of_memLp hw.memLp (hpv t ht))
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply] at hi hup hvp
  simp_rw [inner_sub_right]
  rw [hi, hup, hvp, sub_self]
